top_module.name: adaptive_aero_control_top
top_module.description: Top-level active-aerodynamics controller integrating configuration, request issuance, response validation, safety enforcement, watchdog timeout, stale detection, clamp enforcement, and fallback command generation around an external surrogate service.
top_module.functionality: Implements a bounded, safety-critical transport-and-supervision shell for an external aerodynamic surrogate service. On configuration writes it captures mode enable, watchdog limit, freshness limit, command min/max clamp bounds, geometry descriptor ID, control profile selection, and hold-last-good policy. On a request event it packages a compact request record containing request_tag, geometry_descriptor_id, flow-conditions summary including stream_velocity_mps, profile selector, and health/status bits into a 128-bit request stream. It increments/manages request_tag to detect stale, duplicated, or out-of-order responses. It accepts only responses whose request_tag matches the outstanding transaction and whose age is within the configured freshness window, otherwise latches fault and enters fallback. It drives deterministic safe aerodynamic commands in fallback, clamps all commands to configured bounds before asserting act_cmd_valid, and supports optional hold-last-good behavior only when explicitly configured. It provides busy, request_pending, response_valid, stale_detected, timeout_detected, clamp_applied, fallback_active, and fault_latched status bits. Reset initializes the design to a safe fallback condition with outputs deasserted or conservative defaults.
responsibilities: Capture compact configuration registers and expose readback status through a 64-bit register window.
Generate one outstanding request per transaction with bounded metadata only.
Track request_tag, issue time, response age, and transaction state for matching and freshness checks.
Validate response packet integrity, tag matching, and timeout compliance before accepting a command.
Clamp accepted or fallback commands to configured min/max bounds before actuator presentation.
Assert deterministic fallback command on invalid, stale, malformed, late, or unavailable service conditions.
Avoid deadlock by returning to IDLE or FALLBACK and allowing new requests after fault handling.
Expose safety/status bits and keep outputs bounded and synthesizable for FPGA implementation.
top_module.reset_behavior: Synchronous reset drives the FSM to IDLE and clears outstanding transaction context, request_tag tracking, status flags, response-valid indication, clamp-applied indication, timeout/stale/fault latches, and command valid. Actuator command data resets to a conservative safe fallback value, and request/response handshakes are deasserted until a fresh request is issued.
behavior_rules: FSM shall include IDLE, ISSUE_REQUEST, WAIT_RESPONSE, VALIDATE_RESPONSE, APPLY_COMMAND, FALLBACK, and TIMEOUT states.
Configuration writes shall capture mode enable, watchdog limit, freshness limit, command min/max clamp bounds, geometry descriptor ID, control profile selection, and hold-last-good policy.
Request packets shall remain within 128 bits and contain explicit request_tag, geometry_descriptor_id, stream_velocity_mps summary, profile selector, and health/status bits.
The request_tag shall increment or otherwise be managed such that stale, duplicated, or out-of-order responses are detectable.
Response acceptance shall require exact request_tag match with the outstanding transaction context and freshness age within the configured window.
Timeout watchdog shall count from request issue to response acceptance and force FALLBACK when the limit is exceeded.
Stale-data detector shall compare response age and request_tag against the outstanding transaction context.
Malformed, invalid, stale, duplicate, out-of-order, or late responses shall latch fault and transition to FALLBACK or TIMEOUT as applicable.
Fallback command shall be deterministic and conservative, selected from configuration or a hardcoded safe default.
Command clamping shall be combinational or one-cycle registered but must prevent out-of-range actuator commands from propagating.
act_cmd_valid shall only assert when the command has passed validation and clamping.
Hold-last-good command is permitted only when explicitly configured; otherwise faults shall force deterministic fallback command output.
Service unavailability or lateness must not deadlock the design; recovery to IDLE or FALLBACK with subsequent request capability is required.
No wide geometry, mesh, pressure, flow-field, or surrogate tensor ports are permitted.
Any future payload/history FIFO storage shall be technology-neutral and BRAM-backed rather than flattened into registers.
The FPGA implementation path shall not instantiate Sky130 hard macros.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_request_packer
modules.description: Internal request packet formatter that builds the bounded 128-bit model request record from compact flow-condition and configuration metadata.
modules.functionality: Packages compact control metadata into a fixed-width request packet and emits a request issuance pulse together with the request_tag that is used by the supervisor for matching and aging.
responsibilities: Compose bounded request metadata without exposing large payloads.
Preserve request_tag for end-to-end response matching.
Encode geometry descriptor, profile selector, stream velocity summary, and health/status bits in a fixed packet.
Operate only when enabled and a request event is accepted.
Hold req_valid until req_ready handshake completes or supervisor consumes the packet.
Support downstream external service transport without coupling to physics internals.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears packet state, deasserts req_valid and request_issued_pulse, and zeros the outgoing request record until a new event is accepted.
behavior_rules: Request packet width shall not exceed 128 bits.
Request packet shall include request_tag, geometry_descriptor_id, flow-conditions summary including stream_velocity_mps, profile selector, and health/status bits.
Request issuance shall be bounded and deterministic.
No inference or solver behavior shall be implemented here.
No large payload FIFO shall be inferred; only compact control metadata is handled.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_response_guard
modules.description: Internal response validator and watchdog manager that checks request_tag matching, freshness, timeout, and malformed packet conditions before any command is accepted.
modules.functionality: Consumes the external model response stream, compares the returned request_tag to the outstanding transaction, applies freshness and watchdog checks, and emits only validated compact command data when safe to do so.
responsibilities: Accept only packets that match the outstanding request_tag.
Reject stale, duplicated, out-of-order, malformed, or late packets.
Compare request age against freshness and watchdog limits.
Provide explicit fault, stale, and timeout indications to the supervisor.
Expose a bounded 32-bit validated command candidate only after validation.
Drive rsp_ready according to supervisory consumption policy.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset clears all detection flags, deasserts response_valid and rsp_ready, and zeros validated outputs until a fresh valid response is received.
behavior_rules: Response acceptance requires exact request_tag match with the outstanding transaction context.
Response acceptance requires age within the configured freshness window.
Timeout shall be measured from request issue to response acceptance and force fault when exceeded.
Only compact command-relevant outputs may be emitted; no surrogate tensor exposure is allowed.
No physics solver behavior shall be implemented here.
Outputs used for actuator application must remain bounded at 32 bits.

modules.name: adaptive_aero_control_safety_fallback
modules.description: Internal safety and fallback command generator that clamps accepted commands to safe bounds, chooses deterministic fallback commands on fault, and optionally holds the last known good command only when configured.
modules.functionality: Generates the final bounded actuator command. When no fault is present, it clamps the validated command to configured safe bounds before valid assertion. On fault, it emits a deterministic conservative fallback command selected by configuration or default. If explicitly configured, it may hold the last known good command; otherwise fault forces fallback command output.
responsibilities: Clamp command values to configured min/max bounds.
Prevent out-of-range values from reaching the actuator interface.
Select deterministic safe fallback command on fault or invalid data.
Support explicit hold-last-good policy only when enabled.
Provide final act_cmd_valid gating and final act_cmd_data output.
Expose clamp_applied and fallback_active indicators.
modules.reset_behavior: Reset sets the output command to a conservative fallback default, deasserts act_cmd_valid, clears clamp_applied and fallback_active, and initializes last_good_command_out to a safe value.
behavior_rules: Command clamper shall be combinational or one-cycle registered but must never allow out-of-range actuator values to propagate.
Command output shall be marked valid only after validation and clamping, or when a deterministic fallback command is intentionally asserted.
Hold-last-good behavior shall be used only when explicitly configured.
Fallback command shall be deterministic and conservative.
The output width shall remain within 32 bits.
No solver or model inference behavior shall be embedded in this module.

top_level_connections.description: Global synchronous clock fanout to all sequential modules.
Global active-low synchronous reset fanout to all safety-critical modules.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_enable
inter_module_signals.description: Decoded mode enable control captured from configuration and propagated to internal modules.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_watchdog_limit
inter_module_signals.description: Configured watchdog limit used by the response guard timeout supervision.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_freshness_limit
inter_module_signals.description: Configured response freshness limit used for stale-data rejection.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_cmd_min_bound
inter_module_signals.description: Configured lower actuator clamp bound.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_cmd_max_bound
inter_module_signals.description: Configured upper actuator clamp bound.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_geometry_descriptor_id
inter_module_signals.description: Compact geometry descriptor identifier used in request packaging.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_profile_selector
inter_module_signals.description: Control profile selection used both in request packaging and fallback profile choice.

inter_module_signals.name: cfg_hold_last_good_enable
inter_module_signals.description: Explicit policy bit controlling whether the last known good command may be retained on fault.

inter_module_signals.name: request_tag
inter_module_signals.description: Outstanding request tag forwarded from request packer to the response guard for matching.

inter_module_signals.name: request_issued_pulse
inter_module_signals.description: Internal issuance indication used by the top-level supervisor to track transaction state.

inter_module_signals.name: request_packet
inter_module_signals.description: Bounded 128-bit request packet containing compact model request metadata.

inter_module_signals.name: request_valid
inter_module_signals.description: Request stream valid handshake from request packer to the top-level external transport port.

inter_module_signals.name: request_ready
inter_module_signals.description: Ready handshake returned by the external transport endpoint into the request packer.

inter_module_signals.name: response_stream_valid
inter_module_signals.description: External response valid handshake presented to the response guard.

inter_module_signals.name: response_stream_data
inter_module_signals.description: External response packet presented to the response guard for validation.

inter_module_signals.name: response_ready
inter_module_signals.description: Ready handshake driven by the response guard back to the external response stream.

inter_module_signals.name: validated_command
inter_module_signals.description: Validated compact command candidate from the response guard into the safety/fallback stage.

inter_module_signals.name: response_validated
inter_module_signals.description: Validated response indicator used to gate actuator command generation and report status.

inter_module_signals.name: stale_detected
inter_module_signals.description: Stale-data indicator latched into top-level status.

inter_module_signals.name: timeout_detected
inter_module_signals.description: Timeout indicator latched into top-level status.

inter_module_signals.name: fault_detected
inter_module_signals.description: Fault indicator from the response guard into the fallback supervisor and top-level status.

inter_module_signals.name: clamp_applied
inter_module_signals.description: Indicates whether command clamping was applied to the final actuator command.

inter_module_signals.name: fallback_active
inter_module_signals.description: Indicates that fallback command behavior is active.

inter_module_signals.name: final_act_cmd_valid
inter_module_signals.description: Final actuator command valid handshake driven by the safety/fallback stage.

inter_module_signals.name: final_act_cmd_data
inter_module_signals.description: Final clamped or fallback actuator command driven to the top-level output.

inter_module_signals.name: actuator_ready
inter_module_signals.description: External actuator ready handshake returned into the safety/fallback stage.

inter_module_signals.name: request_pending_status
inter_module_signals.description: Internal request-pending indication used to coordinate request issuance timing.

inter_module_signals.name: stream_velocity_mps_meta
inter_module_signals.description: Compact stream velocity summary forwarded into request packaging.

inter_module_signals.name: health_status_meta
inter_module_signals.description: Health/status summary forwarded into request packaging.

registers.name: cfg_window
registers.description: 64-bit compact configuration and status read/write window. Captures mode enable, watchdog limit, freshness limit, command min/max clamp bounds, geometry descriptor ID, control profile selection, and hold-last-good policy using defined field packing.

registers.name: status_window
registers.description: 64-bit status readback window containing busy, request_pending, response_valid, stale_detected, timeout_detected, clamp_applied, fallback_active, fault_latched, and auxiliary debug bits.
